subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The Facebook Papers
description: A 60-second lesson on The Facebook Papers.

hook.text: In 2021, Frances Haugen leaked internal documents proving Facebook knew its platform caused harm.

buildup.text: Internal research showed Instagram worsened body image issues in teenage girls. Facebook buried the findings.

discovery.text: Documents revealed that Facebook's algorithm prioritized outrage because anger drives more engagement.

twist.text: Facebook rebranded to Meta right after the leaks — a name change, not a behavior change.

climax.text: The Facebook Papers proved the company chose profit over safety — and knew exactly what it was doing.

punchline.text: They knew the harm. They chose the profit.

quiz.question: What did Facebook's internal research reveal about Instagram?
options: It worsened body image issues in teenage girls
It improved mental health for all users
It had no measurable effect on wellbeing
